messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Routing-policy alert: sudden increase in customer-quality regressions (avg quality drop ~15%) correlating with cost-routing rollout at 19:00 UTC. Affected variants: redwood-medium-quant, redwood-small-quant. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/routing/alerts/1887654321
Alex (oncall): Acknowledged. Paging runtime + ML. @Rami @Mika can you triage? Any immediate mitigation we can flip?
Rami (runtime): looking. I see a spike in requests routed to 'redwood-medium-quant' from eu-west and us-east. Latency fine but flagged quality errors from our eval harness are up. Pulling policy history.
Mika (ml): on it. Running quick diff on model variants. Initial check: quantized-medium variant has lower eval pass rate on our safety+accuracy suite vs baseline fp16 by ~13%.
Alex (oncall): customer impact? which customers and how many requests?
Rami (runtime): rough numbers from tracer: 2.1M requests in the last 30m, ~4% of global traffic, error/low-quality reports ~18k. Top affected orgs: Cartwheel, Pressly, AcmeMaps.
Olivia (support): Support is seeing ~12 tickets referencing hallucinations/formatting issues from Cartwheel. Churn risk flagged.
Mika (ml): the model mapping in the cost routing rollout looks suspect. I pulled the policy blob:```yaml
fallback_policy:
  mode: prefer_cost
  rules:
    - match: "*"
      prefer: "cheapest_available"
variants:
  - name: redwood-medium-quant
    cost_score: 0.25
    est_quality: 0.60
  - name: redwood-medium-fp16
    cost_score: 0.8
    est_quality: 0.88
```
Mika (ml): The policy lacked a min_quality threshold and the cost_score weights pushed traffic to 'redwood-medium-quant' even when estimated quality < customer min. That's the regression vector.
Rami (runtime): I can flip the routing knob to disable cost_preference globally. Command I'm about to run:```bash
redwoodctl routing set --policy active --prefer-cost false --dry-run false
```
Alex (oncall): Do it. Also can we pin affected orgs to fp16 variants while we investigate?
Rami (runtime): Pinning now for Cartwheel + Pressly + AcmeMaps:```bash
redwoodctl pin set --org Cartwheel --variant redwood-medium-fp16 --ttl 6h
redwoodctl pin set --org Pressly --variant redwood-medium-fp16 --ttl 6h
redwoodctl pin set --org AcmeMaps --variant redwood-medium-fp16 --ttl 6h
```
Rami (runtime): cost preference disabled and pins applied. Monitoring ingestion of quality signals...
Siva (sre): Noted. Creating incident page and running PG handoff docs. Severity: Sev2 for now (customer-impact, partial regression).
Olivia (support): Notifying customer success contacts for Cartwheel to prep mitigation copy.
Mika (ml): Quick follow-up tests: running an offline eval of quantized-medium on latest production prompt set (10k prompts) — will post numbers in ~10m.
Alex (oncall): Jules, you’re next oncall in ~30m. If we don’t fully mitigate before handoff, please take lead.
Jules (next-oncall): Got it. Standby.
Mika (ml): Eval complete: quantized-medium pass rate 72/100 vs fp16 85/100 on the sampled prompt set. Failure modes: factual hallucinations, truncated JSON outputs.
Mika (ml): Immediate recommendation: mark redwood-medium-quant as "do-not-route" for any policy that prioritizes cost until we improve calibration. Also add min_quality: 0.80 to routing decision.
Rami (runtime): I can add a safety check in router: require est_quality >= route.min_quality if present. Patch ready, deploying to staging then prod:```diff
- prefer_cost: true
+ prefer_cost: false
+ route_min_quality: 0.8
```
Alex (oncall): After we confirm metric rollback, we'll keep CostRouting off for 2 hours and monitor. Also open a customer-facing incident note. Olivia can you draft?
Olivia (support): Drafting and will circulate.
Siva (sre): Pager duty note added. Handoff checklist created: root cause, mitigation, customers impacted, timeline.
Alex (oncall): Status update: mitigated (cost preference disabled, pins applied, quantized-medium marked do-not-route). Quality deltas returning toward baseline within 15m.
Mika (ml): Postmortem action items: 1) Add pre-rollout eval gating for any quantized variants with a public prompt suite and min_quality thresholds; 2) Add automatic rollback if quality regressions >10% for 5m; 3) Add a routing-level flag to prefer_stability for enterprise orgs.
Rami (runtime): Infra follow-ups: 1) implement route_min_quality enforcement in router, 2) add finer-grained trace linking policy decision -> chosen variant for faster triage, 3) safe defaults for unopened policies.
Olivia (support): Customer impact summary for CS: affected ~350 org requests / minute at peak, 3 customers with actionable tickets, outreach in progress.
Alex (oncall): Closing timeline notes: 19:00 rollout (cost routing) -> 19:17 alert -> 19:19 cost_pref disabled & pins -> 19:34 quality trending back -> 19:45 marked mitigated. Next: run retrospective tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Assigning owners: Mika -> ML gating, Rami -> router checks, Olivia -> customer comms, Siva -> postmortem doc.
Jules (next-oncall): I have the handoff. If anything degrades, escalate to PD.
IncidentBot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-311. Postmortem link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-311/postmortem
Alex (oncall): Thanks team. We'll follow up in postmortem with final RCA and planned timeline for safe re-enabling of cost routing. :white_check_mark:
